arxiv-2103-09633.title: Physics potential for the H → \rightarrow ZZ ∗ decay at the CEPC Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-2103-09633.creator: Ryuta Kiuchi addr1, Yanxi Gu addr2, Min Zhong addr2, Lingteng Kong addr3, Alex Schuy addr4, Shih-Chieh Hsu email2, addr4, Xin Shi email1, addr1, Kaili Zhang addr1
arxiv-2103-09633.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ryuta Kiuchi addr1, Yanxi Gu addr2, Min Zhong addr2, Lingteng Kong addr3, Alex Schuy addr4, Shih-Chieh Hsu email2, addr4, Xin Shi email1, addr1, Kaili Zhang addr1. The precision of the yield measurement of the Higgs boson decaying into a pair of Z Z bosons process at the Circular Electron Positron Collider (CEPC) is evaluated.

arxiv-2203-11468.title: The role of antisymmetric functions in nonlocal equations
arxiv-2203-11468.creator: Serena Dipierro, Giorgio Poggesi, Jack Thompson, Enrico Valdinoci
arxiv-2203-11468.description: Abstract . We use a Hopf-type lemma for antisymmetric super-solutions to the Dirichlet problem for the fractional Laplacian with zero-th order terms, in combination with the method of moving planes, to prove symmetry for the semilinear fractional parallel surface problem .

arxiv-2410-05508.title: How Do We Observe Relational Observables?
arxiv-2410-05508.creator: Emily Adlam
arxiv-2410-05508.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Emily Adlam. In theories with a diffeomorphism symmetry, such as general relativity and canonical quantum gravity, it is often proposed that the empirical content is encoded in relational observables. But how do relational observables actually make contact with experience? I argue that this question can only be answered by providing a schematization of the observer which is appropriate for the context of a diffeomorphism-invariant theory.

arxiv-2504-02235.title: Clustering of Conditional Mutual Information via Quantum Belief-Propagation Channels
arxiv-2504-02235.creator: Kohtaro Kato 1, Tomotaka Kuwahara 2,3,4
arxiv-2504-02235.description: Abstract Conditional mutual information (CMI) has recently attracted significant attention as a key quantity for characterizing quantum correlations in many-body systems. While it is conjectured that CMI decays rapidly in finite-temperature Gibbs states, a complete and general proof remains elusive.

arxiv-2510-23291.title: Selmer ranks under quadratic twists satisfying the Heegner hypothesis
arxiv-2510-23291.creator: Alexandros Konstantinou
arxiv-2510-23291.description: Abstract . We investigate variations of Selmer ranks under quadratic twists satisfying the Heegner hypothesis. In particular, starting with an elliptic curve E / ℚ E/\mathbb{Q} with partial 2 2 -torsion and a common relaxed Selmer group, we derive explicit formulae describing the effect of twisting on Selmer ranks in terms of matrices over 𝔽 2 \mathbb{F}_{2} .

pmc-10672222.title: Genetic Diversity and Population Structure of Leptosphaeria biglobosa from the Winter Oilseed Rape Region in China
pmc-10672222.creator: Kang Zhou, Jing Zhang, Long Yang, Guoqing Li, Mingde Wu
pmc-10672222.description: Phoma stem canker (blackleg), caused by the fungi Leptosphaeria maculans (anamorph Phoma lingam) and L. biglobosa, is one of the most devastating diseases in oilseed rape (Brassica napus L.) production worldwide. However, the population structure and genetic variation of L. biglobosa populations in China have rarely been investigated.

pmc-10717404.title: CD56 polysialylation promotes the tumorigenesis and progression via the Hedgehog and Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathways in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
pmc-10717404.creator: Yuli Jian, Lin Zhang, Li Gong, Mengting Ding, Xiaoxin Sun, Xiao Yu, Shaohui Lv, Jinjing Li, Deyong Yang, Shujing Wang
pmc-10717404.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundCD56 has been observed in malignant tumours exhibiting neuronal or neuroendocrine differentiation, such as breast cancer, small-cell lung cancer, and neuroblastoma. Abnormal glycosylation modifications are thought to play a role in regulating tumour cell proliferation, migration, and invasion. Nevertheless, the exact roles and molecular mechanisms of CD56 and polysialylated CD56 (PSA-CD56) in the development and progression of clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) remain elusive.

pmc-11447603.title: Retrospective study of detecting oesophageal injuries post neck trauma: CTA versus fluoroscopy
pmc-11447603.creator: Audrey R. Rumhumha, Nicholas Christofides, Pravani Moodley
pmc-11447603.description: BackgroundTimely detection of oesophageal injuries post-penetrating neck trauma is imperative because of the associated high morbidity and mortality. Patients commonly undergo both CT angiography (CTA) and contrast swallow studies (fluoroscopic oesophagography) when oesophageal injury is suspected.ObjectivesTo determine the radiological findings of oesophageal injury after penetrating neck trauma comparing CTA and fluoroscopic oesophagography at a single tertiary centre.

pmc-12371107.title: Prediction modeling of land surface temperature in relation to land cover dynamics and health risk perception analysis in barishal city of Bangladesh
pmc-12371107.creator: Irteja Hasan, Osman Goni, Zarin Tasnim Katha, Mainul Islam Rabby, Siam Hossain, Arpa Banik, Sabbir Hasan, Iftekhar Rahman
pmc-12371107.description: Rapid urbanization has brought about rapid changes in land-use and land-cover (LULC) patterns, significantly affecting land surface temperatures (LST). This study uses GIS and remote sensing techniques to assess changes in LULC classes and their impacts on LST at the Barishal City Corporation (BCC) of Bangladesh.

pmc-12816619.title: Green waste biochar and plant growth-promoting bacteria enhance tomato growth under combined nutrient deficiency and salinity stress
pmc-12816619.creator: Soumaya Tounsi-Hammami, Munawwar Ali Khan, Mahra Alqemzi, Salama Ali Almehairi, Aneesa Rasheed Anwar
pmc-12816619.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study characterized a green-waste-derived biochar from date palms and ghaf trees and investigated its potential as a soil amendment with halotolerant Bacillus spp. to improve tomato seedling quality under dual stress of salinity and nutrient deficiency. Biochar was produced through pyrolysis at 450 °C and then characterized for yield, pH, electrical conductivity, proximate analysis, surface morphology, energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy, and heavy-metal content. Its effectiveness was tested both alone and in combination with a Bacillus sp.

pmc-12853821.title: Molecular convergence of luminal androgen receptor and molecular apocrine defines a distinct entity in ER-negative breast tumors
pmc-12853821.creator: Adrien Borgel, Etienne Camenen, Catherine Miquel, Philippe Bertheau, Luis Teixeira, Jacqueline Lehmann-Che
pmc-12853821.description: BackgroundEstrogen receptor–negative breast cancers are clinically heterogeneous. Two subtypes, Luminal Androgen Receptor and Molecular Apocrine Breast Cancers, are both defined by androgen signaling but identified through distinct transcriptomic classifiers. Their relationship remains unclear despite overlapping features.MethodsWe analyzed transcriptomic and genomic data from public and institutional cohorts using two classification systems.

pmc-13260428.title: Mapping the intellectual structure of the refrigerated vehicle routing problem: research perspectives and structural knowledge gaps
pmc-13260428.creator: Daniel Aristizábal Torres, César Augusto Peñuela Meneses, Jhon Jairo Santa Chávez, Luis Miguel Escobar Falcón
pmc-13260428.description: IntroductionThe Refrigerated Vehicle Routing Problem (RVRP) has evolved from a specialized extension of the classical Vehicle Routing Problem into a multidisciplinary research domain integrating cold chain logistics, sustainability, inventory coordination, and dynamic intelligent systems. Despite its rapid growth, the field's intellectual structure remains fragmented across methodological traditions, limiting cross-perspective integration.

pmc-13535096.title: Retinoic acid and FGF signaling interact to control elongation and lineage specification in a mouse gastruloid model
pmc-13535096.creator: Mehmet Yildiz, Noëlle Dommann, Tugce Kardelen Hasdemir, Esther de Vries, Anna Alemany, Pascale F Dijkers, Niels Geijsen
pmc-13535096.description: Axial elongation and cell fate decisions during early embryonic development are regulated by gradients of signaling molecules, such as retinoic acid (RA) and fibroblast growth factor (FGF). To assess the role of RA in vitro, studies have relied on its direct addition to the medium, which can produce teratogenic effects.

pmc-13558985.title: Suspected recurrent sarcoma resembling feline injection-site sarcoma with spinal cord invasion in a cat
pmc-13558985.creator: Emily A Pope, Arin Cox, Christopher Premanandan, Kim A Selting, Laura E Selmic
pmc-13558985.description: Case summaryA 6-year-old, neutered male domestic shorthair cat was referred for evaluation of a recurrent subcutaneous mass on the right caudodorsolateral hip, 4 months after excision of a presumed feline injection site sarcoma (FISS). Advanced imaging revealed a bilobed soft tissue mass closely associated with the sciatic nerve and rectum.

pmc-13639044.title: PRMT6 acts as a pro-angiogenic factor in colorectal cancer
pmc-13639044.creator: Haifeng Han, Xin Zhang, Mingxin Jin, Yali Chu, Fengjun Liu, Hui Qu, Cheng Chen
pmc-13639044.description: The progression of colorectal cancer (CRC) is highly dependent on tumor angiogenesis, a process primarily regulated by hypoxia-inducible factor HIF-1α. This study focuses on the mechanistic role of protein arginine methyltransferase 6 (PRMT6) in CRC angiogenesis and reveals that PRMT6 is significantly overexpressed in CRC tissues, stabilizing HIF-1α via the autophagy-lysosome pathway.
